name: infra-preflight
description: Before `docker compose up|start|restart` on a ~/infra service, checks that Tailscale is Running and that the service's BIND_IP matches the Tailscale IPv4; otherwise refuses the command with the fix.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Check Tailscale is Running and BIND_IP matches before `docker compose up|start|restart` on ~/infra services. Off: no check.
